article.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Bishkek to attend SCO summit, take over organisation’s chairmanship
article.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif reached Bishkek on Monday for a three-day official visit to Kyrgyzstan, where he is scheduled to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Council of Heads of State meeting.

article.title: PM Shehbaz meets Iranian President Pezeshkian on sidelines of SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan
article.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Kyrgyzstan on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Council of Heads of State meeting on Monday, according to the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO).PM Shehbaz arrived in Bishkek earlier today on a three-day official visit from Aug 31 to Sep 2, at the invitation of President Sadyr Nurgozhoevich Zhaparov to attend the SCO Council of Heads of State meeting.The leaders of China, Iran, Turkiye, Russia, and India were in Kyrgyzstan for the two-day SCO summit. The regional bloc, which also includes Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Belarus, is celebrating its 25th anniversary.On the sidelines of the summit, PM Shehbaz and Pezeshkian held a “warm and cordial” meeting, during which they reaffirmed the close and longstanding ties between both countries, the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) said.They emphasised the need to further strengthen bilateral relations across all areas of mut...

article.title: PM Shehbaz to visit Kyrgyzstan for SCO summit, bilateral talks
article.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif will travel to Kyrgyzstan from August 31 to September 2, 2026, for an official visit that will include his participation in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Council of Heads of State meeting, the Foreign Office said on Monday.
